name: Bridged_Transfer_Template
description: This flow showcases the different external transfer types on Webex Contact Center. It showcases two examples, one bridged transfer example that connects to an external IVR while maintaining call control. After the bridged transfer the call is transferred back into WebexCC and queued to an agent. The second option is a blind transfer to an external target. The call is in a "fire and forget" mode where call control is lost from WebexCC and call control is transferred to the external third party.
